summary: FDCTech, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing that effective September 9, 2026 it relocated its principal executive offices from Irvine, California to Limassol, Cyprus, approved by unanimous written board consent. No securities, stake, price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The move places senior management nearer operating subsidiaries Crestmark Trading Ltd. (Malta), Alchemy Prime Limited (UK), and the payments business, which generate substantially all revenue. Delaware incorporation, registered agent, domestic issuer status, reporting obligations, executives, and board are unchanged. Relocation is not expected to materially affect results. No arbitrage angle; routine administrative relocation disclosure.
